subject.title: feat(workboard): clarify proof provenance and diagnostics

question: Should Workboard publish `independently_verified` as a caller-declared, non-attesting proof-provenance label across its public plugin contract?
rationale: The implementation deliberately changes the meaning shown to operators and external callers while stating that Workboard does not perform verification; only the feature owner can confirm that this is the intended durable authority boundary.

options.title: Approve the provenance model
options.body: Publish the two-value label as caller-declared metadata after removing the unnecessary schema-version bump and adding live behavior proof.

options.title: Keep proof provenance internal
options.body: Retain diagnostic improvements but avoid exposing a durable public verification label until an attestation contract is designed.

options.title: Define a stronger verification contract
options.body: Specify who can independently verify evidence and what data validates that claim before adding the public enum.

recommendation.title: Approve the provenance model
recommendation.body: Publish the two-value label as caller-declared metadata after removing the unnecessary schema-version bump and adding live behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor supplied the proposed Workboard semantics; current-main feature ownership could not be established from the available read-only inspection results.
